name: Shounen wa Koyoi mo Tsuki to Kuruu
original_name: 少年は今宵も月と狂う
source:
This is a short story happening after events of Tsuki Kurui no Yoru. With nightfall Philer gets increasingly frenzied.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这是继月久留之夜事件之后发生的短篇故事。夜幕降临，菲尔勒变得越来越疯狂。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
